whyEn: Weight-3 core chapter: the BC practical is marked along the seven-component model this material feeds, and written scenarios open with assessment logic. Nail phase order, GCS scoring, unstable criteria and reassessment intervals; wherever textbook wording clashes with the BC model, the bcAlerts version wins.
whyZh: 3 星权重核心章。BC 实操考试整场就是沿七阶段评估模型逐项打分，笔试情景题也从评估逻辑切入。优先吃透四件事：阶段顺序、GCS 计分、不稳定判据、重评间隔；凡教材说法与考纲冲突，一律以 bcAlerts 标注的考纲版本为准，并配合网站『评估模型』页一起复习。

sections.titleEn: Why Assessment Is the Master Skill (Introduction & Elements)
sections.titleZh: 本章定位与评估的两大部件（引言与要素）

points.en: Two building blocks: history taking (questions, listening, observing presentation and setting) plus physical assessment (hands-on exam exploring the chief complaint and hunting injuries or illness signs).
points.zh: 评估由两大部件组成：病史采集——提问、听答、观察患者表现与所处环境；体格检查——动手检查，围绕主诉深挖并寻找伤情或疾病征象。

points.en: The first question of the initial assessment is always whether any life threat exists; early findings drive ground-versus-air transport and destination choice.
points.zh: 初步评估的第一个问题永远是：有没有威胁生命的情况？评估早期的发现直接决定走陆路还是空运、送哪家医院。

points.en: Job sequence: identify problems, rank them most to least serious, build a prehospital care plan, then execute it.
points.zh: 工作主线四步、顺序固定：找出问题（主诉/呼救原因）→ 按轻重排序 → 制定院前救护计划 → 执行计划。

points.en: Information sources ranked: the patient first, then family, friends or witnesses, then the scene itself, then device data (monitor, glucometer, oximetry, capnography).
points.zh: 信息来源有层级：患者本人是首要来源，其次是家属/朋友/目击者，再叠加现场环境信息与仪器数据（心电监护、血糖仪、血氧、二氧化碳波形）。

points.en: Only some patients need spinal restriction or a breathing treatment; every patient needs a full assessment. An obvious-looking problem never justifies skipping it.
points.zh: 不是每个患者都需要脊柱固定或雾化治疗，但每个患者都需要完整评估——『问题看起来很明显』从来不是跳过评估的理由。

sections.titleZh: 现场评估：安全、机制与资源

points.en: Scene assessment comes first on every call, and crew safety outranks patient contact; an injured paramedic delivers zero care.
points.zh: 现场评估是每一趟任务的第一步，且救护员自身与队友的安全排在接触患者之前——受伤的救护员对患者毫无价值。

points.en: PPE floor: gloves on every call; eye protection when splash or spray is possible; a fitted HEPA or N95 for inhaled-particle risk; gown when indicated. In doubt, over-protect.
points.zh: PPE 底线：每趟必戴合尺寸手套；可能有血液体液飞溅就加护目；有吸入颗粒风险戴贴合的 HEPA/N95；必要时穿隔离衣。拿不准时宁可防护过度。

points.en: Collision and rescue scenes stack hazards: unstable vehicles, live traffic, jagged metal and glass, fire or explosion risk, downed power lines, hazardous materials.
points.zh: 碰撞与救援现场是多重危险叠加：不稳定车辆、往来车流、金属断茬与碎玻璃、火灾爆炸风险、垂落电线、危险物质。

points.en: Smoke is incomplete combustion: toxins, pathogens, carcinogens. Body plus respiratory protection is mandatory before entering any toxic atmosphere.
points.zh: 烟雾是不完全燃烧的产物，含毒素、病原体与致癌物；进入毒性环境前必须同时具备躯体防护和呼吸防护。

points.en: Treat crime scenes as ongoing, not past tense. Police should enter and secure first; arriving ahead of them, request support immediately rather than juggling scene control and care.
points.zh: 犯罪现场别当『过去时』看——暴力随时可能重演。理想流程是警方先进场控场；若你先到，应立即请求警力，而不是一边控场一边救人——凶手还可能带着更强火力折返。

points.en: A deteriorating scene (rising voices, aggressive gestures, threats) means retreat to the vehicle until secured; bring the patient along only when clearly achievable safely.
points.zh: 现场恶化（人群音量升高、出现攻击性动作或威胁）就撤回车内等待控场；只有在明确能安全做到时才把患者一并带走——这是你的判断题。

points.en: Stimulant users days into sleeplessness run paranoid, unstable and armed, with excited-delirium risk; call police early for any patient who could turn violent.
points.zh: 冰毒/快克使用者常处于多日无眠的末端：偏执、情绪不稳、几乎总带武器，且有激越性谵妄风险。对任何可能转向暴力的患者，请求警力支援永远不要犹豫。

points.en: Set a perimeter so bystanders never become patients. Weather exposure breeds hypothermia, hot asphalt burns; in a hostile environment do the initial assessment, fix life threats, move to the ambulance.
points.zh: 拉出警戒范围，防止围观者变成新伤员。环境本身也伤人：风雨里拖久了是低体温，正午柏油路面会烫伤。环境不友好时的打法：做完初步评估、处理生命威胁、尽快把人挪进救护车这个受控环境。

points.en: MOI is the set of forces acting on the body; evaluating it predicts which injuries are likely and how severe. NOI is the general illness type on medical calls.
points.zh: MOI（受伤机制）＝作用在人体上的力；评估 MOI 可以预判『可能伤了什么、大概多重』。内科呼叫则要尽快从患者或旁人处确定 NOI（疾病性质）。

points.en: Generic dispatch wording hides combined problems: hypoglycemia causes the fall, a dysrhythmia or stroke causes the crash. Keep several possibilities open.
points.zh: 『男子不适』这类模糊派遣词背后常是复合问题：低血糖导致摔倒、心律失常或卒中导致撞车。评估全程保持多种可能性并存，别提前锁死结论。

points.en: Several patients with matching symptoms points to carbon monoxide or food poisoning; multiple patients always means triage plus requesting the resources you will allocate (fire, police, rescue, utilities, hazmat).
points.zh: 多名患者症状雷同，优先想一氧化碳中毒（或其他毒性物质）与食物中毒；只要出现多患者，就必须检伤分类，并按需求呼叫增援——消防、警察、救援、公共设施、危险品团队。患者体型过大也应尽早叫人。

points.en: Scene assessment closes with a spinal motion restriction decision driven by the scene read and MOI, settled by the time you reach the patient.
points.zh: 现场评估的收尾动作：根据现场情况与 MOI 决定是否需要脊柱活动限制——到达患者身边时就要落实，而不是体检做到一半才想起。

sections.titleZh: 初步评估：60-90 秒内锁定生命威胁

points.en: Within the first 60 to 90 seconds of looking, talking and touching, you should catch airway, breathing and circulation threats and start a working diagnosis.
points.zh: 看、问、触的头 60–90 秒内，就应识别出气道、呼吸、循环（ABC）三类生命威胁，并基于首发表现与主诉开始形成工作诊断——后续体检用来证实或推翻它。

points.en: Two questions structure it: is the patient sick (yes/no qualification), and how sick (severity quantification)? Trauma version: hurt, and how badly.
points.zh: 两问定框架：『病不病？』是定性题，『病多重？』是定量题；创伤版本对应『伤没伤、伤多重』。答完这两问才谈得上排优先级、定计划。

points.en: Speech arriving in one- or two-word bursts is itself a red flag for a very sick patient; chest pain after a stabbing is an obvious priority.
points.zh: 说话只能一两个词一顿地往外蹦，本身就是重症红旗；胸部刺伤后的胸痛更是明摆着的优先级患者。

points.en: Age and gender bend presentations: an older woman's infarct may bring no chest pain at all, unlike the classic picture in an older man.
points.zh: 年龄与性别会改写临床表现：老年女性心梗可能完全没有胸痛，与老年男性的『教科书表现』差别很大；问诊方式也要随年龄与心智成熟度调整。

points.en: Mental status is a prime severity indicator: set the baseline at first contact, because a change in consciousness is often the earliest clue of deterioration; in trauma, decide spinal restriction at the same moment.
points.zh: 精神状态是判断病重程度的头号指标之一：初次接触就建立基线，因为意识变化往往是病情转坏的第一条线索；涉及创伤时须同步决定脊柱活动限制。

points.en: AVPU is the fastest scale; A+O x4 adds orientation to person, place, day and event — name and day probe long-term memory, place and event probe short-term.
points.zh: AVPU 是最快的意识分级；再加 A+O×4（人物、地点、日期、事件）细化——记得姓名与日期考长期记忆，知道身在何处、发生了什么考短期记忆。

points.en: GCS is the most reliable, most consistent neurologic yardstick: eye opening out of 4, verbal out of 5, motor out of 6, summed to 3-15.
points.zh: GCS 是最可靠、最一致的神经功能量表：睁眼最高 4 分、言语最高 5 分、运动最高 6 分，相加总分 3–15。

points.en: Score bands: 15 no disability, 13-14 mild, 9-12 moderate to severe, 8 or below severe dysfunction; 3 is the floor.
points.zh: 分档：15＝无神经功能障碍；13–14＝轻度；9–12＝中度（BC 三带：≥13 轻、9-12 中、≤8 重）；≤8＝重度；最低只有 3 分，没有 0 分。

points.en: Report GCS by components, never just the sum — eyes tracking, disoriented speech, obeying commands gives 4/4/6 = 14; eye-to-pain, moaning, withdrawal gives 2/2/4 = 8.
points.zh: 报 GCS 必须拆项：眼随人动＋言语错乱＋能遵嘱＝4/4/6 共 14 分；疼痛才睁眼＋只会呻吟＋疼痛回缩＝2/2/4 共 8 分。总分相同的两个患者，表现可以完全不同。

points.en: Infants and children need the modified scale; adult scoring does not transfer.
points.zh: 婴幼儿要用改良版 GCS，成人计分标准不能直接套用（详见儿科章）。

points.en: Airway asks two things: patent now, and likely to stay patent? Snoring means a position problem (tongue); gurgling or bubbling means fluids — reach for suction.
points.zh: 气道两问：现在通不通？接下来保不保得住？鼾声＝体位问题（舌根后坠）；咕噜声/水泡音＝口咽有血、黏液或呕吐物——上吸引。

points.en: Escalate simple to complex: positioning (head tilt-chin lift without trauma, jaw thrust with trauma), then suction, then OPA/NPA, then supraglottic airway or intubation; bag-mask backs every plan.
points.zh: 气道处理从简到繁：先摆位（无创伤用仰头举颏，疑创伤用双手托颌）→ 吸引 → 口咽/鼻咽通气道 → 声门上气道或气管插管；任何方案都要备好球囊面罩。

points.en: Prolonged suction creates hypoxia, yet clearing the airway to prevent aspiration outranks that concern — suction until clear.
points.zh: 吸引过久确实会造成低氧，但『把气道吸干净、防止误吸』的优先级更高——该吸就吸到通畅为止。

points.en: Infant and toddler tracheal rings are incompletely developed; a wrong head position readily collapses or occludes the airway during positioning manoeuvres.
points.zh: 婴幼儿气管软骨环发育不全，摆头位时角度不对很容易把气管压瘪或堵死——记住各年龄段的解剖差异。

points.en: Breathing asks: any breathing, and is it adequate? Minute volume (rate times tidal volume) is the true adequacy measure — 10 x 500 = 5,000 mL beats 24 x 200 = 4,800 mL.
points.zh: 呼吸两问：有没有？够不够？衡量『够不够』的金标准是分钟通气量＝频率×潮气量：10 次×500 mL＝5,000 mL，而 24 次×200 mL 只有 4,800 mL——喘得快不等于换气多。

points.en: Beyond volume, log rate, work of breathing (accessory muscles), breath sounds, skin colour and mentation; assess by look (rise, symmetry, depth), listen (auscultate), feel (air at the mouth).
points.zh: 除潮气量外还要记录：呼吸频率、呼吸做功（辅助肌参与）、呼吸音、肤色、意识状态；手法仍是看（起伏、对称、深度）、听（听诊呼吸音）、感觉（颊部或手掌探气流）。

points.en: Pulse sites: radial when responsive, carotid or femoral when unresponsive, brachial in infants; count 15 seconds times four, or a full minute if irregular or slow.
points.zh: 摸脉部位：清醒摸桡动脉，无反应摸颈动脉或股动脉，婴儿一律肱动脉；计数 15 秒×4，脉律不齐或过慢时数满一分钟。

points.en: Grade force and rhythm: thready with severe vasoconstriction or hypotension-plus-tachycardia, bounding with hypertension; any irregular pulse is at-risk until proven otherwise (think heart blocks). Report rate, force, rhythm.
points.zh: 脉搏要评强度与节律：细弱＝血管强烈收缩或低血压伴心动过速；洪大＝高血压；节律不齐一律按『未证明安全前视为高危』处理（警惕传导阻滞）。汇报格式：频率＋强度＋节律，如『72，有力，规则』。

points.en: Skin colour, temperature and moisture together read perfusion; use the back of the hand for warmth and moisture, and check lips or conjunctivae in darker-skinned patients.
points.zh: 皮肤颜色＋温度＋湿度合起来就是灌注速读；用手背试温湿（比掌心敏感）；深肤色患者的颜色变化要看口唇与结膜等黏膜。

points.en: Colour decode: red — fever, hypertension, superficial burn, allergy, alcohol, late CO poisoning; white — blood loss, anaphylaxis, hypoglycemia, anxiety; blue — hypoxemia; mottled — shock or DIC; jaundice — liver.
points.zh: 颜色速查：红＝发热、高血压、浅度烧伤、过敏、饮酒、CO 中毒晚期；苍白＝失血、过敏性休克、低血糖、焦虑；发绀＝低氧血症；花斑＝休克（低灌注）/DIC；黄疸＝肝功能异常。

points.en: Palpation decode: hot-dry heatstroke, hot-wet heat reaction, cool-dry cold exposure, cool-wet shock; sympathetic surge sweats, while thoracolumbar cord injury leaves affected skin abnormally dry and cool.
points.zh: 触感速查：热而干＝热射病；热而湿＝体温升高反应；凉而干＝受寒；凉而湿＝休克。交感兴奋出汗；胸腰段脊髓损伤则让受累区皮肤反常地又干又凉。

points.en: Priority group one: CPR or ventilatory/circulatory support in progress, poor general impression, unresponsive, cannot follow commands, laboured breathing, hypoxia not correcting within 1-2 minutes of field intervention.
points.zh: 优先级名单（一）：正在 CPR/呼吸停止/靠通气循环支持维持、总体印象差（一看就不对劲）、无反应、有反应但不能遵嘱、呼吸困难（费力呼吸＝重症）、现场干预 1–2 分钟内纠正不了的低氧。

points.en: Priority group two: shock signs (weak or absent peripheral pulse, sustained hypotension or tachycardia, pale-cool-wet skin), childbirth with any presenting part other than the head, chest pain with systolic under 100 mm Hg, STEMI on ECG, suspected stroke — pin down last-seen-normal.
points.zh: 优先级名单（二）：休克征（外周脉弱或消失、持续低血压、持续心动过速、皮肤苍白湿冷）；分娩先露不是胎头（产后除胎盘外）；胸痛＋收缩压 <100 mmHg（伴心动过速更危险）；ECG 提示 STEMI（time is muscle，直送合适的心脏中心）；疑似卒中——务必问清最后正常时间并送有卒中单元的医院。

points.en: Priority group three: uncontrolled bleeding, severe pain anywhere (especially pain that wakes the patient), multiple injuries or severe burns, any abdominal-injury sign, severe hypertension, inability to move a body part, apparent life-threatening event (apnea plus colour change plus tone change plus choking or gagging).
points.zh: 优先级名单（三）：无法控制的出血（内外都算）；任何部位剧痛（尤其半夜痛醒型）；多发伤或重度烧伤（几个小问题叠成大问题）；任何腹部损伤征象；重度高血压（高血压危象或卒中可能）；肢体不能动；ALTE（呼吸暂停＋肤色改变＋肌张力改变＋呛噎的组合）。

points.en: Priority patient handling: minimal scene time, expedite transport, and shift the focused history and exam to the ride.
points.zh: 确认优先级患者后：现场只做必须做的，尽快转运，重点病史与体检全部挪到车上路途中完成。

sections.titleZh: 重点病史与体检：内科患者（清醒与无反应）

points.en: For responsive medical patients the working diagnosis comes mostly from the history; the focused exam and diagnostics then sharpen it. Start by pinning the chief complaint.
points.zh: 清醒内科患者的工作诊断主要来自问诊；随后的重点体检和仪器只是把它磨准。第一步永远是钉死主诉——多数呼救源于疼痛、不适或身体功能异常。

points.en: Vague complaints ('just not right today') are typical of older patients: slow down, ask precise questions, listen long.
points.zh: 『今天就是不对劲』这类模糊主诉在老年人里非常常见：要放慢节奏、问对问题、耐心听——考验的是问诊功力而不是仪器。

points.en: Expand the complaint with OPQRST, interview with SAMPLE; scan for medical identification (bracelet, necklace, wallet card) flagging allergies, diabetes, cardiac, hypertension or renal disease.
points.zh: 主诉展开用 OPQRST，系统问诊用 SAMPLE；同时留意医疗警示物（手环、项链、钱包卡），上面常标过敏史、糖尿病、心脏病、高血压、肾病等关键信息。

points.en: Past history predicts the present: unmanaged diabetes erodes peripheral circulation, eyesight and kidneys; stable angina drifts unstable, then infarcts. A first-ever acute problem is serious until proven otherwise.
points.zh: 既往史常常就是现病史的前传：血糖长期失控会逐步毁掉外周循环、视力与肾功能；稳定型心绞痛会转为不稳定、再进展为心梗。反过来，患者从未经历过的急性新问题，一律按重症对待直到排除。

points.en: Current health status inventory: diet, all medications including OTC and herbal, allergies, exercise, alcohol and tobacco, recreational drugs, sleep, immunizations.
points.zh: 当前健康状况清单：饮食习惯、全部用药（含非处方药与草药）、过敏（环境与药物）、运动量、烟酒、毒品（如患者愿意说）、睡眠、疫苗接种（流感/破伤风）。

points.en: Let the complaint drive the exam: breathlessness demands early breath sounds, a numb leg demands pulse-motor-sensory checks on both limbs; skip irrelevant manoeuvres. Most responsive-medical problems sit in head, heart, lungs or abdomen.
points.zh: 体检跟着主诉走：喘不上气→尽早听呼吸音；腿麻→双侧对比查脉搏-运动-感觉；主诉脖子僵就别去按肚子听心音——时间要花在刀刃上。清醒内科患者的常见问题集中在头、心、肺、腹四处。

points.en: Head complaints: palpate for trauma, check facial droop or asymmetry for stroke, pupil size for drug use, red conjunctivae for alcohol or drugs; headache often rides on elevated blood pressure.
points.zh: 头部问题（意识改变、头痛）：触诊找创伤痕迹；查面部不对称/口角歪斜（卒中线索）；瞳孔过大过小提示毒品；结膜充血提示酒精或药物；头痛常伴血压升高。

points.en: Cardiac complaints: pulse regularity, hypoperfusion skin signs, crackles from pulmonary edema, JVD (failure or pneumothorax), peripheral edema (right-sided failure). Cardiogenic shock: profound hypotension with sustained tachycardia, mortality beyond 80%.
points.zh: 心脏问题：查脉律、找灌注差的皮肤征（苍白湿冷）或发绀、听湿啰音（肺水肿）、看颈静脉怒张（心衰或气胸）、查外周水肿（右心衰）。警惕心源性休克——严重低血压＋持续心动过速，死亡率可超 80%。

points.en: Breath-sound decode: absent fields — pneumothorax; a silent chest — status asthmaticus; consolidation — pneumonia; wheeze localized or diffuse — asthma or bronchoconstriction; crackles — pulmonary edema, heart failure, toxic inhalation, submersion.
points.zh: 呼吸音判读表：某肺野无音＝气胸；整胸『安静』＝哮喘持续状态（比喘鸣更危险）；实变音＝肺炎；哮鸣（局限或弥漫）＝哮喘/支气管痉挛；湿啰音＝肺水肿、心衰、毒气吸入、溺水。

points.en: Retractions and accessory-muscle use mean rising work of breathing; a tired, fading look signals ventilatory fatigue — the usual prelude to ventilatory failure and arrest.
points.zh: 三凹征/辅助呼吸肌参与＝呼吸做功增加；而『越来越累、蔫下去』的神情是通气疲劳——它往往是通气衰竭乃至呼吸心跳停止的前奏，比喘本身更危险。

points.en: Abdominal pain mechanisms: visceral (hollow-organ stretch, crampy and diffuse), somatic (sharp and localized, or more diffuse when blood, gastric content or urine hits the peritoneum), referred (felt away from the source organ).
points.zh: 腹痛三机制：内脏痛＝空腔脏器牵张平滑肌，绞痛且弥散；躯体痛＝皮肤、腹壁与肌层痛纤维受刺激，锐利局限（血液、胃内容物或尿液进腹膜则偏弥散）；牵涉痛＝病灶在此、痛在彼处。

points.en: Referred-pain map: flank pain with kidney stones, inner-thigh pain from appendicitis or PID, scapular pain from cholecystitis, waves of groin pain from renal colic.
points.zh: 牵涉痛地图：肾结石→腰胁部；阑尾炎或盆腔炎→大腿内侧；胆囊炎→肩胛区；肾绞痛→腹股沟阵发波浪样痛。

points.en: Quadrant map: LUQ — ruptured spleen (sickle cell crisis, mononucleosis); LLQ with constipation, vomiting and fever — diverticulitis; RLQ — appendicitis; RUQ — cholecystitis; diffuse pain in childbearing-age women — ectopic pregnancy or ovarian cyst until excluded.
points.zh: 四象限速查：左上腹＝脾破裂（镰状细胞危象、单核细胞增多症史）；左下腹＋便秘/恶心呕吐/发热＝憩室炎；右下腹＝阑尾炎；右上腹＝胆囊炎；育龄女性弥漫腹痛＝先想宫外孕、卵巢囊肿破裂等妇产科急症。

points.en: Guarding or rigidity flags internal bleeding or an inflamed organ; abdominal findings run general, so weigh them together with history and vitals.
points.zh: 腹肌紧张/防卫提示内出血或脏器炎症等多种原因；但腹部查体信息普遍偏『泛』，必须结合病史与生命体征一起解释。

points.en: Vitals during this phase: a full set with auscultated blood pressure, exact pulse and respiratory rates, temperature. Blood pressure often shifts last as shock deepens — never wait for it.
points.zh: 本阶段生命体征：完整一套——听诊法血压、精确的脉搏与呼吸频率、体温。切记休克逐期演进时，血压往往是最后才动的指标——别等血压掉了才认休克，血压的底线任务是维持终末器官灌注。

points.en: Tilt test for volume depletion (nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, syncope, GI issues): positive with systolic drop up to 20 mm Hg, diastolic rise of 10, heart-rate rise of 20; one minute between positions, same arm, same spot; repeat after fluids.
points.zh: 体位试验评估容量不足（恶心呕吐、腹泻、晕厥、消化道问题）：收缩压下降（可达 20 mmHg）＋舒张压升 10 mmHg（脉压变窄）＋心率升 20 次/分即为阳性；换体位后间隔 1 分钟再测，同臂同位置绑袖带；记录节律与伴随症状，补液后复测。

points.en: Unresponsive medical patients get trauma-style assessment: full head-to-toe plus oximetry, capnography, monitor and glucometer; family accounts help but never equal the patient's own.
points.zh: 无反应的内科患者按创伤思路查：完整从头到脚＋血氧、二氧化碳波形、心电监护、血糖仪全上；家属朋友的叙述有用，但质量永远比不上患者亲口说的。

points.en: Positioning: trauma ruled out — recovery position (left lateral) to drain fluids and prevent aspiration; trauma possible — neutral alignment, fitted rigid collar, spinal motion restriction per protocol.
points.zh: 体位处理：排除创伤→左侧卧恢复体位，利于引流呕吐物血液、防误吸；不能排除创伤→中立位对线、合尺寸硬质颈托、按当地规程做脊柱活动限制。

points.en: Take at least two sets of vitals — baseline, then serial after first interventions — to trend improving, static or worsening; recheck breath sounds. Unresponsive medical equals unstable: rapid transport plus en-route reassessment.
points.zh: 生命体征至少两套：先基线、干预（给氧/输液）后几分钟再测一套，对比判断在好转、原地还是恶化，时间允许就继续加测画趋势；顺手复听呼吸音。无反应内科患者一律视为不稳定高危——快速转运，途中持续评估。

sections.titleEn: Focused History & Physical — Trauma & the Rapid Trauma Assessment
sections.titleZh: 重点病史与体检：创伤患者与快速创伤评估

points.en: Isolated injury lets you focus at once; multisystem trauma demands finding every injury, ranking by severity, and tracking how injuries interact.
points.zh: 孤立伤可以直接聚焦处理；多系统创伤则必须先尽量找全所有伤，再按严重度排序处置，并全程思考各伤之间如何相互放大。

points.en: One hypotensive episode doubles mortality in serious traumatic brain injury — recognizing and correcting lost perfusion pressure is life-or-death.
points.zh: 重型颅脑损伤只要出现过一次低血压，死亡率就翻倍——识别并纠正灌注压不足在这类患者身上就是生死线。

points.en: Ugly injuries distract: a twisted compound ankle is not lethal, the invisible internal bleed is. Lives outrank limbs.
points.zh: 『吓人的伤』会造成视觉干扰：脚踝开放骨折扭成怪角度并不致命，看不见的体内出血才致命。保命永远排在保肢前面。

points.en: Entering this phase, replay the whole initial assessment and re-examine the MOI — that composite flags who must go priority to the trauma centre.
points.zh: 进入本阶段先把初步评估的信息整体回放一遍、重审 MOI——两者合起来决定谁需要按优先级直送创伤中心。

points.en: Adult significant mechanisms: fall above 6 m (one storey is 3 m); major compartment intrusion; partial or full ejection; a death in the same compartment; alarming vehicle telemetry; pedestrian or cyclist struck, thrown or run over; motorcycle or ATV crash above 30 km/h (BC figure — textbook prints 32); penetrating head, chest or abdominal wounds.
points.zh: 成人显著 MOI 清单：坠落超 6 米（一层楼＝3 米）；座舱明显侵入；部分或完全甩出车外；同座舱有人死亡；车载数据提示高风险；行人/骑车人被撞飞、碾过或高速撞击；摩托/全地形车 >30 km/h 碰撞（BC 数值，教材写 32）；头胸腹穿透伤。速度与侵入的考试数值以 BC 考纲为准，见 bcAlerts。

points.en: Child thresholds: fall above 3 m or two to three times body height; fall under 3 m with loss of consciousness; bicycle collision; vehicle crash at 40 km/h or more.
points.zh: 儿童阈值：坠落超 3 米或超过自身身高 2–3 倍；不足 3 米但有意识丧失；自行车碰撞；40 km/h 及以上的机动车碰撞。

points.en: Two or more mechanisms stacked (crush plus impalement in one T-bone) markedly raise the odds of serious or fatal injury.
points.zh: 两种及以上机制叠加（如侧撞同时造成挤压伤＋车门饰条穿刺伤）会显著抬高重伤或致死概率——见到叠加机制就上调怀疑指数。

points.en: Belt reading: palpate clavicles under the shoulder strap (subclavian vessels beneath); on short patients the strap rides the neck; a lap belt above the iliac spines risks organ and thoracolumbar injury; harness tucked under the arm plus rollover kills via liver injury.
points.zh: 安全带解读：肩带下方摸锁骨——锁骨下动静脉就在骨下走行；个子矮的人肩带会勒到颈部（软组织＋颈椎风险）；腰带骑到髂嵴上方压住下腹＝脏器与胸腰椎风险；把肩带塞腋下图舒服的人翻车时常死于肝损伤。

points.en: Air bags are secondary restraints: without a belt the occupant still goes down-and-under or up-and-over after the bag deflates. Lift every deployed bag to hunt a bent steering wheel; an undeployed bag can fire spontaneously.
points.zh: 气囊只是『第二道』约束：不系安全带时，气囊瘪下去后人照样钻仪表板下方或飞向方向盘/挡风玻璃。凡气囊弹出，必须掀开看方向盘有没有变形（重大内伤线索）；未弹出的气囊可能随时自爆，接近前排患者要当心。

points.en: A loose or wrong-size child seat forfeits its protection and raises face, head, neck and spine injury risk.
points.zh: 儿童安全座椅装松了或尺寸不合，保护作用直接作废，面部、头颈与脊柱受伤风险大增——评估儿童乘员时要问座椅状态。

points.en: Any trauma patient unresponsive or with altered mentation is a priority transport; the short differential: brain injury, stroke, hypoglycemia, alcohol or drug intoxication.
points.zh: 创伤患者只要无反应或意识改变，一律优先转运创伤中心；快速鉴别四联：颅脑损伤、卒中、低血糖、酒精/药物中毒——个个都可能致命。

points.en: The rapid trauma assessment sits between initial assessment and focused exam, runs on significant-MOI patients after ABC threats are handled, applies DCAP-BTLS per region, and takes 2-3 practised minutes.
points.zh: 快速创伤评估的位置：初步评估之后、重点体检之前；对象＝有显著 MOI 的患者；前提＝ABC 生命威胁已处理；每个部位套 DCAP-BTLS 找伤；练熟后 2–3 分钟完成。

points.en: Before starting: manual cervical stabilization in neutral, recheck mentation against baseline, revisit the transport call — if leaving now, run the survey while packaging.
points.zh: 开始前三件事：徒手中立位固定颈椎；对照基线复查意识；重审转运决定——若决定立即走，就边打包边做这套评估，装车即出发。

points.en: Head and neck order: skull for depressions and crepitus; posterior neck for step-offs before any collar; ears for blood or CSF; orbits and pupils together; nose; mouth (patient runs the tongue along the teeth); neck for JVD, subcutaneous emphysema (air leak) and tracheal shift (a very late pneumothorax sign); then the collar.
points.zh: 头颈段顺序：颅骨查凹陷/骨擦感；上颈托前先摸后颈椎找台阶感与压痛（患者皱一下眉都算线索）；耳内耳后看血液或脑脊液（颅底骨折/脑损伤征）；眶缘与瞳孔双侧同查；鼻；口腔（清醒者让舌头绕牙齿一圈自查松动，无反应者开口看伤情与吸引需求）；颈部查 JVD、皮下气肿（胸腔漏气）与气管偏移（气胸的极晚期征象）；查完才上合尺寸硬颈托。

points.en: Chest and back: clavicles traced thumb-to-shoulder from the suprasternal notch; sternum pressed for stability; rib cage swept from the axillae down; a large bruised area may be a flail segment still splinted by muscle spasm; log-roll to palpate thoracolumbar step-offs.
points.zh: 胸背段：拇指卡胸骨上切迹、沿双锁骨一路摸到肩带部（锁骨是最常骨折的骨之一）；掌压胸骨再左右晃试稳定性（查连枷胸/胸骨骨折）；双手从腋下沿肋弓向下扫查肋骨；大片瘀斑要多想一步——可能是被肌肉痉挛暂时『夹板』住、还没显反常呼吸的连枷段；翻身上板时顺势摸胸腰椎棘突找台阶与穿透伤。

points.en: Abdomen and pelvis: four quadrants for rigidity, guarding, bruising, tenderness; pelvic flexion-compression stops the instant instability appears — further springing worsens vascular injury — then bind; palpate over the bladder; examine the groin only if wet, bloody or painful.
points.zh: 腹盆段：四象限查板硬、防卫、瘀斑、压痛（呻吟或皱眉都算阳性）；骨盆先向下压再向内挤髂嵴，一摸到不稳定立刻停手——继续摇晃会加重血管损伤——并随即绑骨盆带；耻骨上轻触膀胱区；仅当会阴部潮湿、见血或诉痛时才检查外阴。

points.en: Extremities: legs hip-to-ankle for bleeding, swelling, shortening or rotation; pedal pulses palpated simultaneously — asymmetry means vascular disruption; bilateral motor loss says cord, unilateral says musculoskeletal (stroke excepted); arms likewise with distal pulse-motor-sensory; inspect gloves for blood repeatedly.
points.zh: 四肢：下肢从髋到踝查出血与肿胀，短缩或外旋＝骨折/脱位征；双足背动脉必须同时摸——一侧偏弱＝血管损伤警报；双侧运动丧失指向脊髓损伤，单侧多为肌肉骨骼问题（卒中除外）；清醒者加查远端脉搏-运动-感觉；上肢同法；全程反复检查手套上有没有血。

points.en: Right after the survey, baseline vitals — ideally a partner records them during your exam; then mentally compile complaint, event history, medical history, health status and diagnostics into the clinical picture.
points.zh: 评估一结束立即测基线生命体征——有人手就让同伴在你查体时同步测，省时高效；随后把主诉、事件经过、既往史、当前健康状况与仪器数据在脑中拼成完整临床图景，再做处置决策。

points.en: Scan for scars and hardware: sternotomy scar, pacemaker or implanted defibrillator bulge in the chest wall, and medical alert devices of every form.
points.zh: 别漏体表『档案』：胸骨正中切口疤（心脏手术史）、胸壁起搏器/植入式除颤器凸起、以及各种形式的医疗警示标识。

points.en: No significant mechanism: single or minor injuries should show zero systemic involvement; any hypotension means a bigger problem hides — keep assessing until found.
points.zh: 无显著 MOI 的伤者（球场崴脚、滑冰摔出 Colles 骨折、车床飞屑划伤前臂）：不该出现任何全身受累表现；一旦有低血压等系统征象，说明背后另有大问题——继续查，直到找到为止。

sections.titleZh: 详细体格检查：转运途中的精查

points.en: Do it when useful, skip it when not: pointless for a finger laceration, impossible for a crashing patient; typically run en route on trauma patients when transport exceeds 15 minutes, and it takes 15-plus minutes itself.
points.zh: 做与不做都要有理由：手指割伤用不上，危重患者没时间；典型场景是创伤患者转运超过 15 分钟时在车上做，全套本身也要 15 分钟以上；可按主诉裁剪，判断无益就干脆不做。

points.en: Its job: surface problems the focused phase missed, re-evaluate running treatments, launch new ones, and trend the vitals.
points.zh: 它的任务：找出重点体检阶段没暴露的问题；据新信息重新评估已给的治疗；对新发现启动新处理；并复测生命体征、观察趋势。

points.en: Patients are being asked to hand doctor-grade personal detail to a stranger of ten minutes — guard privacy and keep the demeanour fully professional.
points.zh: 患者要向认识才十分钟的陌生人交代平时只告诉相识十年家庭医生的隐私，紧张很正常——保护隐私、举止专业，是这项检查能做下去的前提。

points.en: Mental-status block: appropriateness of appearance and behaviour, posture and motor response, speech and language, thought and perception, insight and judgment, short- and long-term memory, plus new learning — give a phrase, ask for it back in 5 minutes.
points.zh: 精神状态块：外观举止是否得体、姿势与运动反应、言语语言、思维与知觉、自知力与判断力（『确实很难受但今天不去医院，明天再说』就是判断力线索）、长短期记忆，再加新学习能力——给一句短语，5 分钟后请患者复述。

points.en: General survey: consciousness against baseline, skin colour, visible lesions, facial expression, apparent state of health — closing on sick-or-not-sick; then height-weight proportionality, grooming, posture and gait, odd breath or body odours, skin turgor.
points.zh: 整体观察：意识对照基线有无变化、肤色、可见皮损、面部表情（明显焦虑？苍白倦怠似终末期休克？）、总体健康印象——收束到那句老问题『sick or not sick / hurt or not hurt』；再看身高体重比例、衣着卫生、姿势步态、异常口气体味、皮肤弹性。

points.en: Head: palpate the whole cranium but never press depressions (fragments enter the vault); warm wet spots are blood or CSF; orbits from nose outward; pupils for size and reactivity; conjugate gaze plus full-field tracking; raccoon eyes.
points.zh: 头部：整颅触诊，但摸到凹陷绝不加压——会把骨片压进颅腔或脑组织；温热潮湿处＝血或脑脊液；眶缘由鼻侧向外摸上下缘；瞳孔查大小与反应（固定、散大、迟钝）；查双眼共轭凝视与各方向追视；注意熊猫眼（眶周瘀斑）。

points.en: Face and ears: nose drainage bloody versus clear (possible CSF); maxilla and mandible integrity and symmetry; teeth, crowns, bite fit; breath odours like alcohol or ketones; posterior pharynx for suctionable fluids; Battle sign behind the ears; anterior neck for JVD, swelling and tracheal midline.
points.zh: 面与耳：鼻腔分泌物分清带血还是清亮（清亮可能是黏液也可能是脑脊液）；上颌骨下颌骨查完整性与对称；看牙齿裂缺、假牙冠、咬合是否合；闻口气（酒味、酮味）；后咽部有液体就吸；耳道耳廓查伤、耳后找 Battle 征；颈前查 JVD、肿胀，确认气管居中。

points.en: Chest: symmetry, equal excursion, retractions first; flail segments hide behind muscle-spasm splinting early, so recheck at the next auscultation; clavicles and AC-joint range; sternum integrity; percuss hyperresonance (pneumothorax, asthma, COPD) versus hyporesonance (hemothorax); auscultate at least six fields.
points.zh: 胸部：先看对称、等幅起伏与三凹征；连枷段早期可被肌痉挛『夹』住不显反常呼吸——下次听呼吸音时再盯一次；摸锁骨并活动肩锁关节查 ROM；确认胸骨完整；环境安静就叩诊——过清音（气胸/哮喘/COPD）vs 浊音（血胸）；听诊至少六个肺野。

points.en: Cardiovascular: compare distal pulses; pallor with diaphoresis marks sympathetic discharge; sustained bradycardia drops pressure and mentation, tachycardia raises workload and can drop pressure; 3-lead ECG for any cardiac history, 12-lead when significant — trauma hypotension can mask an evolving infarct.
points.zh: 心血管：双侧远端脉对比；苍白＋大汗＝交感放电征；持续心动过缓会拉低血压和意识，心动过速加重心脏负荷也可致低血压；有心脏病史一律 3 导联 ECG，病史显著就上 12 导联——别让创伤性低血压掩盖正在演变的心梗。

points.en: Abdomen: inspect swelling, bruising, rashes, surgical scars; periumbilical blue (Cullen sign) means intraperitoneal hemorrhage — classic culprits ruptured ectopic and acute pancreatitis; palpate quadrants gently but firmly, chasing any moan, guard or grimace; rebound checks rarely belong prehospital.
points.zh: 腹部：视诊查肿胀、瘀斑、皮疹（过敏反应）与手术/外伤疤；脐周发蓝（Cullen 征）＝腹膜腔内出血，最常见于宫外孕破裂与急性胰腺炎；逐象限轻而坚定地触诊，呻吟、防卫、皱眉都值得追下去；反跳痛检查院前基本不做——痛苦大、增益小，阳性即腹膜刺激征。

points.en: Genitalia only on pain, bleeding or wetness: priapism points to spinal cord injury; scrotal hematoma or blood at the meatus suggests urethral disruption and, behind it, pelvic fracture.
points.zh: 外生殖器仅在诉痛、出血或发现潮湿时检查（这些血供丰富的器官受伤会大量出血）：阴茎异常勃起指向脊髓损伤；阴囊血肿或尿道口见血提示尿道断裂——进一步提示骨盆骨折。

points.en: Sexual assault: clothing per local protocol into evidence bags — never biodegradable garbage bags; maximum support without judgment; a same-gender paramedic helps, but care is never delayed for it. Anus and rectum: examine only with trauma history or findings.
points.zh: 性侵个案：衣物按当地规程作为证据封存（禁用可降解垃圾袋）；全程支持、关怀、不带评判；同性别救护员参与更好，但绝不能为此延误救治。肛门直肠：仅在有创伤史或征象时检查，处理出血或休克等需要。

points.en: Peripheral vascular: work upper to lower limbs for asymmetry, bruising, pallor or mottling; check temperature and moisture; palpate both sides simultaneously; one weak pulse with pallor or cyanosis equals vascular compromise.
points.zh: 外周血管：自上肢到下肢查不对称、瘀斑、苍白或花斑；查皮温与湿度；双侧同时触脉，比较强度、频率、节律；一侧脉明显偏弱＋苍白/发绀＝血管受累。

points.en: Musculoskeletal: global look at position and function; posture betrays scoliosis or a stroke lean; red inflamed joints suggest arthritis, warm red swollen limb areas a clot; range of motion active first, then against your resistance — the first isolates joint problems, the second muscle weakness or innervation trouble; compare grips.
points.zh: 肌肉骨骼：先整体看肢体位置与功能是否正常；坐立姿势能暴露脊柱侧弯或卒中性偏斜；关节红肿提示关节炎，肢体红肿发热提示血栓；ROM 先让患者自主活动（明显下降＝关节问题），再对抗你的阻力活动（下降＝肌力萎缩或神经支配问题）；双手握力对比。

points.en: Nervous system, five mini-exams: mental status (COASTMAP), motor (smooth versus jerky, bilateral grips), cranial nerves, deep tendon reflexes at knees and elbows only, sensory (sharp-dull, position, vibration, dermatomes, distal-proximal and side-to-side comparison).
points.zh: 神经系统五连查：精神状态（用 COASTMAP 走一遍，含三词记忆测试）；运动（动作平滑还是抽动、双侧握力）；颅神经速查；深腱反射只查膝、肘（院前查更多没有必要）；感觉（锐钝辨别、位置觉、振动觉，沿皮节远近对比、左右对比）。

points.en: Close the loop: record every finding, take one more set of vitals, recheck breath sounds.
points.zh: 收尾三件事：所有发现落记录、再测一套生命体征、复听呼吸音。

sections.titleZh: 持续评估：到院前的循环复查

points.en: Second only to the initial assessment in importance, it cycles continuously until handover: every 15 minutes for stable patients, every 5 for unstable.
points.zh: 重要性仅次于初步评估，从转运开始持续循环到向急诊交接为止：稳定患者约每 15 分钟一轮，不稳定患者必须做到每 5 分钟一轮。

points.en: Each cycle: repeat the initial assessment, retake vitals and breath sounds, repeat the focused assessment, check every intervention; trends tell you whether treatments work.
points.zh: 每轮内容＝重做初步评估＋复测生命体征与呼吸音＋重做重点评估＋逐项核查已给干预；趋势变化就是疗效判定书——问题在好转还是恶化，一目了然。

points.en: Mentation first, against baseline: if it slips, ask whether the airway is still protected; with doubt, move to an advanced airway.
points.zh: 先查意识、对照基线：意识在下滑时立刻自问『气道还保得住吗』；有疑问就考虑建立高级气道，别等误吸发生。

points.en: Airway can close in a blink from swelling, bleeding or a position shift; suction at the first gurgle — preventing aspiration beats treating it; verify tube position with lung sounds, oximetry and capnography, and re-verify after every transfer or position change.
points.zh: 气道可因肿胀、出血或体位改变瞬间失守；一听到咕噜声马上吸——防误吸远胜于治误吸；插管后用呼吸音＋血氧＋二氧化碳波形确认管位，且每次搬动（地面上板、现场上车、床对床）后都要重新确认——管子移位最常发生在这些时刻。

points.en: Breathing fixes: hypoventilation — bag-mask with oxygen; hypoxia — high-concentration oxygen; diminished or absent sounds with JVD and progressive dyspnea — decompress the chest. Ventilatory fatigue, above all in children, is the classic pre-disaster sign: take the airway over.
points.zh: 呼吸对策：通气不足→球囊面罩＋氧辅助通气；低氧→高浓度氧疗；呼吸音减弱/消失＋颈静脉怒张＋进行性呼吸困难（气胸三征）→胸腔减压。通气疲劳（血氧渐降、神情越来越累）在儿童身上是灾难前的经典信号——直接替患者管理气道。

points.en: Circulation read: pale-cool-wet skin — shock; cyanosis — desaturation; mottling — end-organ-dysfunction-stage shock. Soaked dressings get fresh layers stacked on top, never removed; watch the pressure for decompensation.
points.zh: 循环速读：苍白湿冷＝休克；发绀＝血氧下降；花斑＝终末器官功能障碍期休克。敷料渗透就在原位加盖新敷料重新包扎、不揭旧层；血压紧盯失代偿苗头，确认所有出血都已控制。

points.en: Pulse trends carry diagnoses: progressive tachycardia — ongoing bleeding, hypoxia or evolving cardiogenic shock; sustained or worsening bradycardia — rising intracranial pressure (trauma or stroke) or end-organ-stage shock.
points.zh: 脉搏趋势本身就是诊断：进行性增快＝还在出血、低氧或心源性休克进展中；持续或渐重的减慢＝颅内压上升（创伤/卒中）或休克终末期。

points.en: Re-plan every cycle: all life threats covered? priorities still right? Step transport up, divert closer, or set an air-ambulance rendezvous when worsening; step back to routine when stabilized — the safer ride.
points.zh: 每轮重审计划：生命威胁都处理了吗？优先级要不要改？恶化就升级转运——提速、改送更近的医院、或约空运接驳；稳定下来就降回常规转运，这反而是更安全的选择。

points.en: Check therapies against expected outcomes: a 500-mL crystalloid bolus for GI bleeding should raise the pressure and slow the pulse — no response is itself information.
points.zh: 对照预期疗效核查：消化道出血推注 500 mL 晶体液后，理应血压上行、脉搏下行——没出现预期变化，本身就是重要情报。

points.en: Priority patients get at least three sets of vitals even on a short run, usually four or five — enough points to draw a trend line.
points.zh: 优先级患者至少三套生命体征（短途也一样），通常四到五套——点够多才能连出趋势线，而不是几个孤立数字。

points.en: Two patterns to name on sight: Cushing reflex — slowing pulse, rising pressure, erratic respirations — a grave head-trauma sign; Beck triad — narrowed pulse pressure, muffled heart tones, JVD — cardiac tamponade, usually from penetrating chest trauma.
points.zh: 两组必背组合：Cushing 反射＝脉搏渐慢＋血压渐升＋呼吸不规则——颅脑创伤的凶险信号；Beck 三联征＝脉压变窄＋心音遥远＋颈静脉怒张——心包填塞，多见于胸部穿透伤。

points.en: Close each cycle on the complaints: did nitroglycerin move the 9-out-of-10 pain? did the second salbutamol ease breathing? Anything worsening means an unseen problem or a failing intervention — then start the next cycle.
points.zh: 每轮以主诉收束：硝酸甘油后 9 分胸痛降了没？第二剂沙丁胺醇后呼吸顺了没？任何还在恶化的项目都意味着有未发现的问题或干预失效；没到医院，就接着做下一轮——所以它才叫持续评估。

atScene.en: Reading the scene before entry is your single best act of self-protection: unneutralized subtle dangers grow teeth once your attention shifts to the patient.
atScene.zh: 进场前把现场读一遍，是你能为自己做的最重要的一件事：那些没被识别、没被排除的隐性危险，会在你的注意力转向患者之后才露出獠牙。第一眼判断同时决定这是个可控现场，还是随时失控的现场。

atScene.en: Never chart mental status as semiconscious, lethargic or obtunded — clinically useless words; give AVPU or GCS numbers instead.
atScene.zh: 精神状态别写『半昏迷』『嗜睡』『迟钝』这类模糊词——临床上毫无信息量；用 AVPU 分级或 GCS 数字说话。

atScene.en: You assess a person, not a monitor. Explain each device as you attach it; the seconds spent drain patient anxiety.
atScene.zh: 你评估的是人，不是机器。接每台设备时顺口解释它是什么、为什么用——几秒钟的动作，明显降低患者焦虑，也换来更好的配合。

atScene.en: On a large chest, fan both hands' fingers wide to judge equality of rise and catch paradoxical motion.
atScene.zh: 体型大的患者胸廓反常呼吸不好看清：把双手手指尽量张开、扇形贴上胸壁，随呼吸感受两侧起伏是否对称，比目测靠谱。

atScene.en: Nancy's rule: salvaging a life always outranks salvaging a limb — sort injuries by lethality, not by appearance.
atScene.zh: Nancy 的铁律：保命永远优先于保肢。伤情排序按致命性排，不按吓人程度排。

atScene.en: Body language is an intervention: get level with the patient's eyes; towering over a frightened person reads as intimidation.
atScene.zh: 体态本身就是干预：蹲到与患者视线齐平再交流；站着俯视一个受惊的患者，传递的就是压迫感。

confusions.en: 'Assessment always runs in one fixed order.' False — the skeleton stays, but acuity reorders emphasis: unstable patients get packaged, with most assessment finished en route.
confusions.zh: 误区：『评估必须按固定顺序走完』。结构要保住，但重点随病情轻重移动——不稳定患者现场只做必需项，其余评估在转运途中完成。

confusions.en: 'Reassessment is paperwork.' It is the main way deterioration announces itself — trends, not single readings, expose a worsening patient.
confusions.zh: 误区：『重复评估是为了写文书』。它是发现恶化的主要途径——暴露病情的是趋势，不是某一次孤立读数。

confusions.en: 'Scene assessment equals hazard check.' It also delivers mechanism, urgency and probable pathology before you touch the patient.
confusions.zh: 误区：『现场评估就是查危险』。它同时给出受伤机制、紧迫度和可能的病理方向——患者还没开口，现场已经在替他说话。

confusions.en: 'Fast breathing means good breathing.' Adequacy lives in minute volume: 24 shallow breaths can move less air than 10 deep ones.
confusions.zh: 误区：『呼吸快说明通气好』。够不够看分钟通气量——24 次浅快呼吸换的气可能还不如 10 次深慢呼吸多。

confusions.en: 'Alert on AVPU means neurologically fine.' An alert patient can still be disoriented, GCS 14, and deteriorating — grade orientation and GCS separately.
confusions.zh: 误区：『AVPU 是 A 就没事』。清醒的患者照样可以定向力错乱、GCS 只有 14 且正在恶化——A+O×4 和 GCS 要另外打分。

confusions.en: 'The worst-looking injury is the worst injury.' The twisted ankle grabs the eye; the silent splenic bleed kills. Hunt the lethal, not the dramatic.
confusions.zh: 误区：『最吓人的伤最重』。扭成怪角度的脚踝抢眼球，不出声的脾破裂才要命——找致命伤，别被戏剧性画面带走。

confusions.en: 'SpO2 at 100% means well oxygenated.' Carbon monoxide poisoning reads normal or perfect on the oximeter; cold hands or nail polish read falsely low.
confusions.zh: 误区：『血氧 100% 就是氧合好』。CO 中毒患者的读数可以完全正常甚至 100%；手凉、涂指甲油又会假性偏低——读数必须结合临床解释。

confusions.en: 'A deployed air bag means the driver is protected.' It is a secondary restraint; unbelted occupants still travel down-and-under or up-and-over. Lift the bag, look for a bent wheel.
confusions.zh: 误区：『气囊弹了人就没事』。气囊只是第二道约束，不系安全带的乘员照样钻仪表板下方或飞向方向盘——掀开气囊查方向盘变形是必做动作。

confusions.en: 'The BC rapid body survey is the head-to-toe exam.' The RBS is a fast life-and-limb sweep inside the primary survey; the true head-to-toe belongs to the secondary survey.
confusions.zh: 误区：『Rapid Body Survey 就是从头到脚检查』。RBS 是 Primary Survey 内快速扫查生命/肢体威胁的动作；细致的 head-to-toe 属于 Secondary Survey，两者深度、时机都不同。

mnemonics.name: AVPU
mnemonics.en: Alert – Verbal – Pain – Unresponsive: the four-rung consciousness ladder; BC ties each rung to an airway action.
mnemonics.zh: 清醒－呼唤有反应－疼痛有反应－无反应，四级意识阶梯；BC 考纲给每一级都绑定了气道处理动作（见 bcAlerts）。

mnemonics.name: E4V5M6（GCS）
mnemonics.en: Eye 4, Verbal 5, Motor 6 — memorize the maxima and the whole scale rebuilds itself.
mnemonics.zh: 睁眼满分 4、言语满分 5、运动满分 6——记住三个满分，整张量表就能自己推出来；最低 3 分不是 0 分。

mnemonics.name: A+O×4
mnemonics.en: Oriented to person, place, day, event; name and day probe long-term memory, place and event probe short-term.
mnemonics.zh: 定向四问：人物、地点、日期、事件。记得姓名与日期考长期记忆；知道身在何处、发生了什么考短期记忆。

mnemonics.name: OPQRST
mnemonics.en: Onset, Provocation, Quality, Region/radiation/referral, Severity, Time — the chief-complaint expander.
mnemonics.zh: 起病、诱因/缓解、性质、部位/放射/牵涉、严重度、时间——主诉展开器，现病史问诊的模板。

mnemonics.name: SAMPLE
mnemonics.en: Signs/symptoms, Allergies, Medications, Pertinent past history, Last oral intake, Events — the history frame.
mnemonics.zh: 症状体征、过敏、用药、相关既往史、最后进食水、事发经过——病史采集总框架。

mnemonics.name: DCAP-BTLS
mnemonics.en: Deformities, Contusions, Abrasions, Punctures/penetrations, Burns, Tenderness, Lacerations, Swelling — run it on every region of the rapid trauma assessment.
mnemonics.zh: 畸形、挫伤、擦伤、穿刺/穿透、烧伤、压痛、裂伤、肿胀——快速创伤评估每个身体部位都过一遍这八项。

mnemonics.name: COASTMAP
mnemonics.en: Consciousness, Orientation, Activity, Speech, Thought, Memory, Affect, Perception — the detailed mental-status walk-through.
mnemonics.zh: 意识、定向、活动、言语、思维、记忆、情感、知觉——详细体检阶段精神状态检查的八步导航。

mnemonics.name: BC 初检干预七项
mnemonics.en: Skin, Oxygen, Airway, Position, Bandage, Pelvic binder, Blanket — the official BC primary survey intervention list (not a textbook mnemonic).
mnemonics.zh: 皮肤、氧、气道、体位、包扎、骨盆带、保暖毯——BC 考纲 Primary Survey 官方干预清单（考纲步骤原文，非教材口诀），实操中边做边报。

selfCheck.qEn: What are the GCS component maxima? Which band does a total of 9 fall into? Score this: eye opening to pain, moaning only, withdrawing from pain.
selfCheck.qZh: GCS 三项各自满分是多少？总分 9 分属于哪一档？疼痛才睁眼、只能发出呻吟、疼痛时肢体回缩——各得几分、共几分？
selfCheck.aEn: Eye 4, verbal 5, motor 6; totals 3-15. Nine sits in the 9-12 moderate band (BC: ≥13 mild, 9-12 moderate, ≤8 severe). The example scores E2+V2+M4 = 8, severe dysfunction.

selfCheck.qEn: Recite the seven BC model components in order, then the steps inside the Primary Survey.
selfCheck.qZh: 按 BC 考纲背出评估模型七个组成部分的顺序，再背 Primary Survey 内部步骤顺序。
selfCheck.aEn: RSE, Primary Survey, Secondary Survey (history, vitals, head-to-toe), Protocols, Treatments, Load and Transport, Records and Reports. Primary: LOC, spinal precautions, airway, breathing, circulation, rapid body survey, interventions, transport decision.
selfCheck.aZh: RSE→Primary Survey→Secondary Survey（病史、生命体征、head-to-toe）→Protocols→Treatments→Load & Transport→Records & Reports；Primary Survey 内部：LOC→脊柱保护→气道→呼吸→循环→Rapid Body Survey→干预七项→转运决定。

selfCheck.qEn: Under the BC guidelines, which numeric mechanisms alone make an adult unstable?
selfCheck.qZh: BC 考纲下，哪些带数字的受伤机制可直接把成人判为不稳定？
selfCheck.aEn: Free fall above 6 m (~20 ft); intrusion over 0.3 m occupant side or 0.5 m any site including roof; ejection, or a death in the same compartment; auto versus pedestrian or cyclist above 30 kph; motorcycle crash above 30 kph.
selfCheck.aZh: 坠落 >6 米（约 20 英尺）；座舱侵入乘员侧 >0.3 米或任意部位（含车顶）>0.5 米；被甩出车外或同座舱有人死亡；汽车撞行人/骑车人 >30 kph；摩托车事故 >30 kph。

selfCheck.qEn: Ongoing assessment intervals? Minimum vital-sign sets for a priority patient?
selfCheck.qZh: 持续评估的频率要求是什么？优先级患者最少要几套生命体征？
selfCheck.aEn: Every 15 minutes stable, every 5 minutes unstable; at least 3 sets even on a short transport, usually 4 or 5.
selfCheck.aZh: 稳定患者约每 15 分钟一轮，不稳定患者每 5 分钟一轮；优先级患者短途也要至少 3 套生命体征，常规 4–5 套。

selfCheck.qEn: Positive tilt-test criteria and measurement rules?
selfCheck.qZh: 体位（tilt）试验的阳性标准与测量要点？
selfCheck.aEn: Systolic drop up to 20 mm Hg, diastolic rise of 10 (narrowing pulse pressure), heart rate up 20 beats/min; wait 1 minute between positions, same arm and location; repeat after fluid replacement.
selfCheck.aZh: 收缩压下降（可达 20 mmHg）、舒张压上升 10 mmHg（脉压变窄）、心率上升 20 次/分即为阳性；每个体位间隔 1 分钟再测、同臂同位置绑袖带；补液后要复测。

bcAlerts.topicZh: 阶段命名：教材五阶段 vs 考纲七部分
bcAlerts.bookEn: Five textbook phases: scene assessment, initial assessment, focused history and physical exam, detailed physical exam, ongoing assessment.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材五阶段：现场评估→初步评估→重点病史与体检→详细体检→持续评估。
bcAlerts.bcEn: Seven components: Rescue Scene Evaluation, Primary Survey, Secondary Survey, Protocols, Treatments, Load and Transport, Records and Reports — answer with these names and this order.
bcAlerts.bcZh: 考纲七部分：RSE→Primary Survey→Secondary Survey→Protocols→Treatments→Load & Transport→Records & Reports。实操与笔试一律用考纲名称与顺序作答；顺序可依呼叫流程灵活，但七部分本身要全。

bcAlerts.topicZh: Primary Survey 的组成与顺序
bcAlerts.bookEn: Textbook initial assessment: general impression, mental status, airway, breathing, circulation, rapid exam, then priority and transport decisions.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材初步评估：总体印象→精神状态→气道→呼吸→循环→快速检查→判优先级与转运决定。
bcAlerts.bcEn: BC fixed order: LOC → Spinal Precautions → Airway → Breathing → Circulation → Rapid Body Survey → interventions (skin, oxygen, airway, position, bandage, pelvic binder, blanket) → Transport Decision. Spinal precautions are an explicit early step, and the transport decision closes the survey.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC 固定顺序：LOC→脊柱保护→气道→呼吸→循环→Rapid Body Survey→干预七项（皮肤/氧/气道/体位/包扎/骨盆带/保暖毯）→转运决定。脊柱保护是紧跟 LOC 的显性步骤，转运决定是 Primary Survey 的收尾——实操按此打分。

bcAlerts.topicEn: Rapid Body Survey vs rapid trauma assessment
bcAlerts.topicZh: Rapid Body Survey vs 快速创伤评估
bcAlerts.bookEn: The textbook's rapid trauma assessment is a separate 2-3 minute DCAP-BTLS tool between initial assessment and focused exam, reserved for significant MOI.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材的快速创伤评估是独立工具：位于初步评估与重点体检之间，仅用于显著 MOI，逐区 DCAP-BTLS，约 2–3 分钟。
bcAlerts.bcEn: BC's Rapid Body Survey lives inside the Primary Survey on every patient: a quick sweep for life- and limb-threats done before the transport decision. Never defer it to a later phase in the practical.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC 的 Rapid Body Survey 是 Primary Survey 的内部步骤、每个患者都做：快速扫查危及生命与肢体的伤情，在转运决定之前完成。实操考试中不能把它推迟到后面的阶段。

bcAlerts.topicZh: 不稳定判定（快速转运类）
bcAlerts.bookEn: The textbook lists ~18 priority findings, from CPR in progress to severe pain and apparent life-threatening events.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材给的是约 18 条优先级清单：从正在 CPR、无反应，到剧痛、ALTE 等。
bcAlerts.bcEn: BC defines unstable by three fixed groups — primary survey findings (altered LOC, airway difficulty, respiratory distress, absent radials, arrest, hemorrhage needing tourniquet or packing, shock skin, suspected CVA, heat stroke, severe hypothermia, suspected cardiac chest pain, anaphylaxis), anatomical findings, and MOI. Any single hit → unstable → transport appropriately.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC 用三组固定标准判不稳定：初检发现（LOC 改变、气道难维持、呼吸窘迫、桡动脉消失、骤停、需止血带/填塞的出血、休克样皮肤、疑似 CVA、热射病、重度低体温、疑似心源性胸痛、过敏性休克）＋解剖学发现＋受伤机制。命中任意一条＝不稳定＝按相应方式转运。考试答题以这三组为准。

bcAlerts.bookEn: Textbook: intrusion >30 cm occupant site / >46 cm any site; pedestrian, cyclist or motorcycle impact >32 km/h.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材：座舱侵入乘员处 >30 cm、任意部位 >46 cm；行人/骑车人或摩托车碰撞 >32 km/h。
bcAlerts.bcEn: BC: intrusion >0.3 m occupant side / >0.5 m any site including roof; pedestrian or cyclist >30 kph; motorcycle >30 kph. Falls >6 m agree. Write the BC numbers on the exam.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC：侵入乘员侧 >0.3 m、任意部位含车顶 >0.5 m；行人/骑车人 >30 kph；摩托车 >30 kph。坠落 >6 m 两者一致。考试写 BC 数值。

bcAlerts.bookEn: The textbook branches by patient type: responsive medical (history first), unresponsive medical (exam first), trauma with or without significant MOI.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材按患者类型分流：清醒内科先问诊、无反应内科先查体、创伤按有无显著 MOI 走不同路径。
bcAlerts.bcEn: BC uses one fixed trio for everyone: History → Vital signs → Head-to-toe examination, plus Functional Inquiry required at the PCP level — an element the textbook does not name.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC 对所有患者用同一组合：病史→生命体征→head-to-toe 检查，PCP 级别还必须加做 Functional Inquiry（功能性问诊）——教材没有点名这一项，实操别漏。

bcAlerts.bookEn: Textbook AVPU is a plain responsiveness ladder (Alert to person, place and day).
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材的 AVPU 只是意识反应分级（A＝对人物、地点、日期清醒定向）。
bcAlerts.bcEn: BC attaches an airway consequence to each level: A may still need help given c-spine concern plus nausea or oral bleeding; V and P — consider or place semi-prone if injuries permit; U — you must intervene and monitor the airway very closely.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC 给每级绑定气道后果：A 级若有颈椎顾虑且恶心/口腔出血仍可能需要协助；V 级伤情允许可考虑半俯卧位；P 级应半俯卧＋密切监测气道并随时干预；U 级无法保护气道，必须干预并极密切监测。按 BC 版本答题。

bcAlerts.bookEn: The textbook names a fifth phase: ongoing assessment q15 min stable, q5 min unstable until handover.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材设独立第五阶段：持续评估，稳定 q15 min、不稳定 q5 min，直到交接。
bcAlerts.bcEn: The BC model has no separate component; reassessment is embedded — reassess the ABCI after each major move (Load and Transport) and every 5-15 minutes during IV maintenance. In the practical, verbalize ABCI reassessment after every major move.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC 模型没有独立的持续评估部分；重评被嵌入流程——每次大幅移动后重评 ABCI（Load & Transport 步骤），PCP 输液维护另有 q5–15 min 复查。实操中每次大移动后都要口头报出重评 ABCI。教材的 15/5 分钟节律仍可作为途中频率参考。
